dealer.name: Viking Truck
dealer.blurb: Dealer & upfitter · septic, vacuum & portable restroom trucks · Forest Park, Georgia
dealer.disclosure: Trucks are sold and upfitted by Viking Truck. Axiant Partners is an independent financing partner and arranges equipment financing; truck pricing, specifications and live availability are provided by the dealer. Financing is subject to credit approval.

hero.intro_html: Built-to-work vacuum trucks and septic trucks for pumping and hauling — from non-CDL 1,500-gallon units up to 6,000-gallon commercial rigs, plus dual-compartment portable restroom trucks. Viking upfits them on Kenworth, Freightliner, International, Mack and Western Star chassis with Masport and NVE vacuum systems, new and used. Every truck here can be financed through Axiant.

finance_card.title: Finance any vacuum truck
finance_card.body: Pick your truck, then finance it through Axiant — spread the cost over the routes it runs and keep your cash working the business.
